# Versions for updates started by Billy 2.6.0 and older.
#
# Those versions update by running `pip install --upgrade -r requirements.txt`
# in Billy's original venv, which otherwise upgrades every package to the
# newest release on PyPI: versions Billy was never tested with, such as a
# Blinka that needs gpiod on a Raspberry Pi 5 and stopped Billy from starting.
# These constraints hold that route to the release locks in this directory.
#
# Generated from linux-aarch64-py311.lock and linux-aarch64-py313.lock; keep
# them in sync (tests/deployment/test_environments.py checks this). Only the
# Python versions those locks cover are constrained; others behave as before.
# Not constrained: pip, setuptools and wheel; the aec-audio-processing wheels,
# which requirements.txt already selects; and openwakeword, which older
# updaters reinstall themselves on Python 3.13 (0.6.0 cannot be installed with
# its dependencies there).
